abc-class.name: ABC Class
abc-class.description: Class from their stored rules or from a value or movement column they provided.

cycle-count.name: Cycle Count
cycle-count.description: From a count CSV, list variances versus the on-hand file if they provided both.

dead-stock.name: Dead Stock
dead-stock.description: Slow-mover list from last-movement or last-sale dates they provided, plus quantity.

lot-expiry.name: Lot Expiry
lot-expiry.description: Flag lots and expiry from their file. Do not invent lots or dates.

pick-pack.name: Pick Pack
pick-pack.description: Pick list from their order export and on-hand or available file.

putaway-list.name: Putaway List
putaway-list.description: Bins the receiver wrote or preferred locations from their map or master.

receiving-match.name: Receiving Match
receiving-match.description: Match purchase order versus packing slip versus dock count.

reorder.name: Reorder
reorder.description: List SKUs at or below their min from their stock file.

rma-returns.name: RMA Returns
rma-returns.description: Condition and sellable flag from their RMA sheet. Do not credit.

transfer.name: Transfer
transfer.description: From site, to site, SKU, quantity, and UOM from their transfer file.
